bandReport.notes:
All four assigned pages were opened and read; no page was empty. Item 83 begins cleanly at the top of p18-c1, so nothing carries over from page 17 (another agent's territory) and no partial item opens this band. Item 100 ends on p21-c2 and closes the paper.

CROPS: no sliced crops. All eight column crops were clean and read in c1-then-c2 order. Each c1 crop carries a thin right-edge sliver of the neighbouring column's item numbers (85./86./87. on p18-c1, 91./92. on p19-c1, 95./96. on p20-c1, 99./100. on p21-c1) - expected overlap, not a slice; no option or stem text bled across. Page 21 (the paper's last content page) was additionally checked against the full-page image p21.png for structure, because the automatic split is documented as unreliable when a final right column is sparse; here both columns are full (97, 98 left; 99, 100 right) and the split is correct.

PRINTED ODDITIES, all transcribed verbatim and NOT corrected:
1. Q88 - the pipeline is printed 'Sumed' (mixed case) in both Statement-I and Statement-II; it is commonly styled SUMED.
2. Q91 - Statement-II prints 'military takeovers/coups d'etat' with an acute accent on the e ('d'état'); kept accented.
3. Q93 - the lead-in line 'While any resolution for the removal of the Speaker of the Lok Sabha is under consideration' is printed with NO terminating punctuation before the numbered list; no colon or full stop has been added.
4. Q94 and Q95 share an option set that departs from the usual UPSC style - (a) '1 only', (b) '1 and 2', (c) '2 and 3', (d) '3 only' - with no 'only' on (b) and (c). Printed that way in both items; transcribed as printed.
5. Q96 - Statement-I prints 'approved The Net-Zero Industry Act' with a capitalised 'The' mid-sentence.
6. Q98 - the lead question reads 'Which of the statements given above are correct ?' (plural 'are'), not the 'is/are' used elsewhere in the paper.
7. Q100 - asymmetric option set as printed: (a) '1, 3 and 4', (b) '2 and 3 only', (c) '2 only', (d) '1, 2 and 4'.

OTHER: Q87 prints a three-column grid whose first column is bare row numbering; following the convention of the sibling bands in this corpus the numbering is folded into the first cell of each row, giving a two-column pipe table. Italic emphasis in the source (the bold-italic 'not' in the Statement-I/II option (b) of Q88/91/92/96/97, the italic 'sine die' in Q95 statement 2, and the italic book titles in Q86) is not preserved as markup; the words themselves are transcribed. No answers, and no hint of an answer, appear anywhere in this file.
